entries.title: Psalms 53:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker; put to Mahalath. Maschil. Of David. The foolish man has said in his heart, God will not do anything. They are unclean, they have done evil works; there is not one who does good.

entries.title: Psalms 53:2
segments: God was looking down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who had wisdom, searching after God.

entries.title: Psalms 53:3
segments: Every one of them has gone back; they are unclean: there is not one who does good, no, not one.

entries.title: Psalms 53:4
segments: Have the workers of evil no knowledge? they take my people for food, as they would take bread; they make no prayer to God.

entries.title: Psalms 53:5
segments: They were in great fear, where there was no cause for fear: for the bones of those who make war on you have been broken by God; you have put them to shame, because God has no desire for them.

entries.title: Psalms 53:6
segments: May the salvation of Israel come out of Zion! When the fate of his people is changed by God, Jacob will have joy, and Israel will be glad.
